Enum Class Syntax.BinaryOp

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Syntax.BinaryOp>
org.clafer.frontend.Syntax.BinaryOp
All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:
Syntax
public static enum Syntax.BinaryOp extends Enum<Syntax.BinaryOp>
The binary operators, with their symbols and levels. Each is left associative: its right operand is one level higher.
